infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Sokoni Driver needs your location to match you with orders and track deliveries in real-time.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sokoni Driver needs your location to match you with orders.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sokoni Driver needs access to the camera to take proof of delivery photos.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Sokoni Driver uses your location to match you with deliveries and to show buyers your position while you are on a delivery.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Sokoni Driver uses your location in the background while you are online, so you can receive jobs and buyers can track their delivery.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Sokoni Driver uses your location to find deliveries near you and to confirm pickup and drop-off.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Sokoni Driver to access your camera for proof of delivery.

plugins.photosPermission: Sokoni Driver uses your photos to upload your rider documents.
plugins.cameraPermission: Sokoni Driver uses the camera to take proof-of-delivery photos.
